custodyProfile.uncertainty: The December 2025 Main Fund PPM names Brown Brothers Harriman (Luxembourg) S.C.A. as AIFMD depositary and distinguishes registered Main Fund shareholder rights from rights exercised through an intermediary. Hamilton Lane's feeder disclosure expressly states that its offering is separate and distinct from SCOPE. Neither source establishes enforceable insolvency-protection or pass-through rights for holders of the tokenized Delaware feeder. The 2026-08-29 structured label, inferred from the Main Fund depositary appointment and separation from Securitize's tokenization stack, was withdrawn on 2026-10-01 under D09. The appointment and technical tokenization remain recorded, but feeder custody, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and reuse terms remain unknown. This narrow legal-boundary review does not newly verify the SEC filing or re-date other provider claims.
